title: BusinessViabilityReport
description: PC2 Phase 0 output: assesses whether a direction/target_bucket/pair/session combination has sufficient raw opportunity to proceed.

schema_version.description: Schema version this report was emitted against.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of report generation.

direction.description: Trade direction. Must not be mixed.

target_bucket.description: Target pip bucket (e.g. 2.5, 3.5, 5, 6, 7, 8). Must be exactly the bucket value, not averaged.

pair.description: Instrument pair (e.g. EUR_USD). No cross-pair averaging permitted.

session.description: Trading session key (e.g. london, new_york, sydney). No cross-session averaging permitted.

trade_count.description: Raw number of qualifying trades in the population for this key.

win_rate.description: Win rate if available; null if insufficient population.

avg_capture_pips.description: Mean pip capture if available; null if insufficient population.

viable.description: True only if this key passes all minimum thresholds for further discovery.

fail_reasons.description: List of reasons this key failed viability check. Empty array if viable=true.

metadata.description: Optional diagnostic metadata from the runner.
